annotations.text:
What a widget can and cannot do, since it shapes all five:

· Real sizes. Small 158x158, medium 338x158, large 338x354 on a 393pt iPhone. Drawn here at those sizes, not scaled up.

· A small widget gets ONE tap target for the whole tile. Separate buttons need medium or large.

· The save button is real from iOS 17 — a Button backed by an AppIntent. The app targets 17, so this is available.

· No scrolling, no swiping, no live data. A widget draws a timeline entry, so the photo and the weather are whatever was last fetched.

· iOS 18 renders widgets tinted and dark on request. Photographs desaturate; paper and type do not.
